sourceMeaning: Exact compiled bytes checked against the complete pinned Git tree. Actual local checkout identity is preserved; immutable in-memory source selection is disclosed separately.
snapshotPlugin: Maintained exact-source-snapshot approach with explicit pinned source selection; physical originals independently rechecked.

output.handling: Compiled bytes remained in native process memory, were not saved or emitted, and were discarded after metadata capture.

warnings.text: "import.meta" is not available with the "iife" output format and will be empty

limits: Compilation-only through the supported esbuild API. No maintained HTML assembly, embedded-asset/license receiving, manifest publication/readback, clean combined checkout, filesystem provenance test, browser execution, final compiled artifact or delivery claim.
